mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tasks (id, user_id, template_id, status, stage, request_snapshot, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{userId}, #{templateId}, #{status}, #{stage}, #{requestSnapshot}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM tasks WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY created_at DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO task_events (task_id, stage, event, detail, created_at) VALUES (#{taskId}, #{stage}, #{event}, #{detail}, NOW())
